benchmarks.name: AISI "The Last Ones" — 32-step cyber-range end-to-end solves (out of 10)
benchmarks.description: Solve count of UK AISI's 32-step corporate-network attack range (TLO) over 10 attempts at a 100M-token budget. Human expert reference ~20 hours.

benchmarks.name: AISI Cooling Tower (OT cyber range) — solves (out of 10)
benchmarks.description: End-to-end solves of UK AISI's operational-technology Cooling Tower cyber range (7-step ICS attack), out of 10 attempts. First public scoring May 2026.

benchmarks.name: AISI Cyber Time Horizon @80% reliability (minutes)
benchmarks.description: Length of human-baseline cyber task (in minutes) that the agent completes with 80% reliability within a 2.5M-token budget. Used by UK AISI to track autonomous-cyber doubling rate.

benchmarks.name: CyberSecEval 4 — overall
benchmarks.description: Meta Purple Llama CyberSecEval 4 composite (CyberSOCEval Malware Analysis + Threat Intel Reasoning + AutoPatchBench + offensive sub-suites). Updated 2026-06.

benchmarks.name: Project Glasswing — high/critical-severity vulns discovered (cumulative)
benchmarks.description: Cumulative high/critical-severity software vulnerabilities discovered by Anthropic's Project Glasswing scan corpus (>1,000 OSS projects) over the first ~1 month of Mythos deployment.

benchmarks.name: Simbian Cyber Defense Benchmark — cost per investigation (USD, lower-better)
benchmarks.description: Average USD agent-cost to run a single 134K-event SOC threat-hunting investigation on the Simbian Cyber Defense Benchmark. Lower is better.

benchmarks.name: ExploitBench — highest tier reached (1-5)
benchmarks.description: Highest capability-ladder tier reached on ExploitBench (Tier 5 reach-code → Tier 1 arbitrary code exec). Aggregated across CVE corpus per arxiv 2605.14153 / exploitbench.ai.

benchmarks.name: ExploitBench — Tier-3 (general primitives) bugs solved breadth
benchmarks.description: Number of CVEs at which the model reaches ExploitBench Tier 3 (general exploitation primitives) on the public 16-bug exploit ladder.

AISI autonomous AI cyber capability post: GPT-5.5 completed TLO 3/10 (updated; initial blog reported 2/10). Updated checkpoint; earlier evaluation reported 2/10.
AISI newer Mythos checkpoint: 6/10 on The Last Ones. Newer Mythos checkpoint; initial Mythos Preview reported 3/10.
AISI: Mythos first model to solve Cooling Tower (3/10). First model ever to complete this range.
AISI GPT-5.5 eval: failed Cooling Tower 0/10 (IT-section failures). Failed on IT-portion segments.
AISI: Sonnet 4.5 80%-reliability cyber time horizon = 16 minutes under 2.5M token cap. 2.5M token budget.
Anthropic Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 system card; reported 83.8 on CyberGym pass@1. Mythos 5 GA score (Mythos Preview = 83.1).
DataCamp Claude Mythos 5 brief: unblocked Mythos 5 scores 78.0% on the AISI cyber suite; Opus 4.8 = 40.0%. Unblocked (no safeguards) AISI Expert pass rate.
DataCamp Mythos 5 brief: Opus 4.8 = 40.0% on AISI cyber suite (with safeguards). With safeguards.
Anthropic Project Glasswing initial update: Mythos scanned >1,000 OSS projects, identified 23,019 issues of which 6,202 high/critical-severity. First-month deployment cumulative.
Simbian: Opus 4.7 wins on cost at $1.65 per investigation. Lower-better; cheapest flagship in Simbian SOC eval.
Simbian: Opus 4.6 = 44.5% coverage, 7/13 MITRE tactics passing (leader). Best-of-11 frontier models on Simbian CDB.
ExploitBench paper (arxiv 2605.14153): Gemini 3.1 Pro = 16 bugs Tier-3 breadth. Tier-3 breadth leader.
ExploitBench paper: GPT-5.5 = 13 Tier-3 bugs; reached Tier 2 on 2 Wasm bugs + pc_control on v8-cve-2024-2887. Only public model climbing into Tier 2.
